plain.li: [renownup,us] They say our family's name is known well beyond the colony now.
[renownup,us] Funny to think strangers know our name.
[renownup,us,tribal] The other camps tell of our family at their fires now, I hear.
[renownup,us,tribal] Our name has walked further than any of us have.
[renownup,us,medieval] I hear there's a song with our name in it now.
[renownup,us,medieval] Our family's name gets a nod in the markets now, I'm told.
[renownup,us,industrial] Somebody said our name made the papers, of all things.
[renownup,us,industrial] Our family's getting a reputation out there.
[renownup,us,spacer] Our name's turning up on channels I've never heard of.
[renownup,us,spacer] Seems our family name carries further than our transmitter does.
[renownup,us,kind] I just hope the name stays a good one.
[renowndown,us] Seems people out there have stopped talking about us.
[renowndown,us] Our name doesn't go as far as it did.
[renowndown,us,tribal] The fires have other stories to tell now.
[renowndown,us,medieval] The singers have found someone else to sing about.
[renowndown,us,spacer] Our name has dropped off the channels.
